svg.title: JiMS button - canonical outline
svg.desc: Canonical JiMS button outline, elasticity 0, drawn at FW = 1000 units (fingertip width). Outer radius 0.29 FW, tip circles r = 0.08682 FW centred at (0, +/-0.26046 FW), joined along common tangents. Source: JiMS-button.js buttonPath(); ratios recorded in JiMS Button Geometry.md.
